​​@successisthedestiny-h3mI completely respect your perspective, brother. And breakout trading is crucial for market structure. The reality is that if support, resistance, and breakouts don't work, retail traders won't create enough buy or sell volume in the market. And until that heavy retail volume (liquidity) is created, big institutional players and algorithms won't be able to play their real manipulation game, because they need counter-orders to match large orders. 

That's why 2 or 3 out of every 10 breakouts are genuine and work perfectly, so that retail traders continue to trust the system and enter the market with greater volume. The rest of the time, manipulation setups are created to capture that volume. My point wasn't to degrade any style, but simply to share this reality of market mechanics. At the end of the day, risk management and discipline are the biggest game. We're all here to learn and master our edge. Wish you pure growth, mate! 🤝🚀
